D.t: Randy Villegas leads by 5.6 in the forecast and wins 84% of simulations. The cushion is about 14,004 votes; a one point swing is about 1,259 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +1.6 and D +12.3. A normal polling error decides it.
